name: Mind flayer (windmill)
backstory: The windmill Mind flayer is a notable mind flayer that can be found sleeping underneath the Abandoned Windmill in Rivington during Act Three. It is brain-starved, as a result of its recent ceremorphosis.
voice_hint: mind flayer (voiced by Stephen Hogan, Harry Myers)
